Authentic and cater with care
Feb 2020 • Couples
I recently visited hanoi with my boyfriend (feb,2020) and went to eat out at night. We wanted to have Vietnamese cuisine so searched on google. It was nearly closing time when we arrived but we were greeted well. The decor is quirky, clean and bigger than expected. One of our favourite restaurant in Hanoi by far. The staffs are very friendly. We both love spicy food and after a while u start to crave the spiciness as most of the Vietnamese dishes aren’t. They catered to our request and rather than putting chillies on top - they took time and actually cooked with it. We had the catfish stew, rice, chicken, spring roll, and stuffed squid. All the dishes were delicious, well balanced and presented beautifully. We enjoyed the food, the ambience and made our night special. A must try restaurant. Highly highly RECOMMENDED!! 👍

Feb 2020 • Couples
We found the restaurant on google: 

the atmosphere is extraordinary and the service is really friendly and top, fluent English! One of the waitresses even helped us to book a taxi for the day after to airport!! Thanks her soooo much! 

The food are also good too:
We had papaya salad with so many different flavors, which I loved, but I still would suggest to be less sweet- somehow not really balanced. Squid stuffed with pork was very good, I like it! But traditional braised duck breast with ginger and pineapple was not really our thing... it was ok, but just not really our favorite taste. 

Still, I’ll recommend this restaurant- if you like to have a nice dinning experience, you won’t be wrong to come here!
